sm: This opinion article from Louder With Crowder covers the arrest of Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza and his daughter, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, at Seattle-Tacoma airport. ICE says both overstayed their visas and that she threw hot coffee on officers, and she faces a charge of assaulting a federal officer. Their attorney, Olia Catala, disputes this, saying the coffee spilled during a struggle, and claims they entered legally and have pending immigration applications. A GoFundMe raised more than eighty-four thousand dollars from about fifteen hundred donations toward a one hundred ten thousand dollar goal. The author argues the public has been brainwashed into rewarding people who break immigration law, and says overstaying a visa does not give lawful residency.
